انتبهت (form VIII)
# اِنْتَبَهْتُ (intabahtu) /in.ta.bah.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# اِنْتَبَهْتَ (intabahta) /in.ta.bah.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# اِنْتَبَهْتِ (intabahti) /in.ta.bah.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# اِنْتَبَهَتْ (intabahat) /in.ta.ba.hat/: third-perso
